The '''Orroman system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the astronomical object [[Orroman]]. At some point, a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] caused a [[Water crisis on Orroman|water crisis]] on Orroman, and the information about the disaster eventually became general knowledge across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Orroman system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square I-14.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
